lines: CASTLE MUSEUM, GROUND FLOOR. HISTORY and the CENTRAL HALL off the ENTRANCE HALL, the CONVENIENCES through HISTORY. The CLOAKROOM, ARTS and SCIENCE off the CENTRAL HALL; MAINTENANCE through the CLOAKROOM, and the STORES through SCIENCE.
Open ten to four. A fourth wing off the CENTRAL HALL has been PAINTED OVER on the plan, in council cream. The rest of it is still right.
The doors off this hall, the CENTRAL HALL and SCIENCE have their names on boards beside them.
VISITORS ARE ASKED NOT TO TOUCH THE EXHIBITS.
The exhibits have been asked the same. Signed, the Attendant.
MAINTENANCE. The gallery lighting and the power shutters are on this breaker.
It is not to be thrown during opening hours. It has been twice, and the dents stay.
THE MODERN METHOD. Presented by the Company. The figure holds a charge in its right hand, and the hand is closed.
Folded into the glove, one page in handwriting you know from a letter: "Shot-firing. Set it, count to five, and be behind something on three. Keep it dry."
The glove is open and empty. The label is still screwed to the plinth.
CLOAKROOM. The stove is lit and the hooks are numbered to sixty. Fourteen of them still have coats.
Nothing comes in here. If it goes badly out there, this is where you will wake.
A portrait in oils, three quarters, a man in a good coat. The brass label reads GNOX GOLDSKIN, BENEFACTOR.
The face has been scratched out. It was done from the front, with something blunt, and not in a hurry.
Under the label, a second plate, smaller: PRESENTED BY THE STAFF OF THE COMPANY, ON THE OPENING OF THE COMPANY SCHOOL.
ENTRANCE HALL. The way out, and the floor plan.
CENTRAL HALL. The CLOAKROOM, ARTS and SCIENCE off it.
HISTORY. THE COUNTY AND THE COMPANY.
Under it, on a card: the CONVENIENCES are through this gallery.
CLOAKROOM. MAINTENANCE through the cloakroom. Staff only.
ARTS. The exhibits are not to leave their plinths while the lights are on.
SCIENCE. THE MODERN METHOD. Presented by the Company.
Under it, on a card: FLOOR KEY No. 3, from ARTS.
STORES. Power shutter. Staff only.
The board has been painted over in council cream, like the end of the plan. The letters show through: MAGIC.
Behind it the arch is plaster, and new, and there is a draught through it.
